ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, $CE \perp BD$ with point $E$ being the foot of the perpendicular. Connect $AE$. If $\angle DCE : \angle ECB = 3 : 1$, then what is the measure of $\angle ACE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that rectangle $ABCD$, with $CE \perp BD$, \\
hence, $\angle DCB = \angle CEB = \angle CED = 90^\circ$, and $OC = OA = OD = OB$, \\
therefore, $\angle OCB = \angle OBC$, \\
since $\angle DCE : \angle ECB = 3 : 1$ and $\angle ECB + \angle DCE = 90^\circ$, \\
thus, $4\angle ECB = 90^\circ$, \\
therefore, $\angle ECB = 22.5^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle OCB = \angle OBC = 90^\circ - \angle ECB = 90^\circ - 22.5^\circ = 67.5^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle OCE = \angle OCB - \angle ECB = 67.5^\circ - 22.5^\circ = 45^\circ$, \\
therefore, $\angle ACE = \boxed{45^\circ}$.

The diagonal BD is connected from D to B, and point E is on BD; from C a perpendicular CE is drawn to BD, and AC is also connected in the figure, so ∠ACE is the angle at point C formed by CA and CE. Then reason: Because ABCD is a rectangle, ∠DCB = 90°. CE divides ∠DCB into ∠DCE and ∠ECB, and ∠DCE : ∠ECB = 3 : 1. Let ∠ECB = x, then ∠DCE = 3x, so 4x = 90°, giving x = 22.5°, therefore ∠DCE = 67.5°. Also because CE ⟂ BD, and CB ⟂ CD, ∠ECB is equal to the angle between BD and CD, namely ∠CDB = x = 22.5°. In the rectangle, △DCB and △DCA are congruent right triangles: DC is the common side, CB = DA, therefore the corresponding angle ∠DCA = ∠CDB = x = 22.5°. So ∠ACE = ∠DCE - ∠DCA = 67.5° - 22.5° = 45°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A is lower-left, B lower-right, C upper-right, D upper-left; E lies on diagonal BD, CE is drawn perpendicular to BD, and diagonal AC is drawn, so ∠ACE is the angle between AC and CE at C. Because CE ⟂ BD and CB ⟂ CD, the angle between CE and CB equals the angle between BD and CD, so ∠CDB = x. Then use the rectangle: right triangles DCB and DCA are congruent because DC is common and CB = DA, so ∠DCA = ∠CDB = x. Therefore ∠ACE = ∠DCE - ∠DCA = 3x - x = 2x = 45°.

所以 ∠ACE = ∠DCE - ∠DCA = 67.5° - 22.5° = 45°。
